title: Continuous bilinear forms on a finite-dimensional normed space are controlled by their values on a basis
statement:
Let L be a finite-dimensional real normed space. There are a natural number N, vectors E_0, ..., E_{N-1} in L and a real constant c >= 0 such that the following hold for all continuous bilinear forms B, B' : L x L -> R and all P, Q in L:
(i) |B(P,Q)| <= c (sum_{r,t} |B(E_r,E_t)|) ||P|| ||Q||;
(ii) |B(P,Q) - B'(P,Q)| <= c (sum_{r,t} |B(E_r,E_t) - B'(E_r,E_t)|) ||P|| ||Q||.
Here r and t range over 0, ..., N-1, and continuous bilinear forms are elements of L →L[ℝ] L →L[ℝ] ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (L : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup L] [NormedSpace ℝ L] [FiniteDimensional ℝ L], ∃ (N : ℕ) (E : Fin N → L) (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c ∧ (∀ (B : L →L[ℝ] L →L[ℝ] ℝ) (P Q : L), |B P Q| ≤ c * (∑ r, ∑ t, |B (E r) (E t)|) * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) ∧ ∀ (B B' : L →L[ℝ] L →L[ℝ] ℝ) (P Q : L), |B P Q - B' P Q| ≤ c * (∑ r, ∑ t, |B (E r) (E t) - B' (E r) (E t)|) * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖
